entries.title: Psalms 81:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Gittith, [A Psalm] of Asaph.>> Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob. {of Asaph: or, for Asaph}

entries.title: Psalms 81:2
segments: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

entries.title: Psalms 81:3
segments: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

entries.title: Psalms 81:4
segments: For this [was] a statute for Israel, [and] a law of the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:5
segments: This he ordained in Joseph [for] a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: [where] I heard a language [that] I understood not. {through: or, against}

entries.title: Psalms 81:6
segments: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots. {were...: Heb. passed away}

entries.title: Psalms 81:7
segments: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah. {Meribah: or, Strife}

entries.title: Psalms 81:8
segments: ¶Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

entries.title: Psalms 81:9
segments: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

words.text: be in thee; neither shalt thou worship

entries.title: Psalms 81:10
segments: I [am] the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

entries.title: Psalms 81:11
segments: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

entries.title: Psalms 81:12
segments: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: [and] they walked in their own counsels. {unto...: or, to the hardness of their hearts, or, imagination}

words.text: . {unto...: or, to the hardness of their hearts, or, imagination}

entries.title: Psalms 81:13
segments: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, [and] Israel had walked in my ways!

entries.title: Psalms 81:14
segments: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

entries.title: Psalms 81:15
segments: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever. {submitted...: or, yielded feigned obedience: Heb. lied}

words.text: themselves unto him: but their time
. {submitted...: or, yielded feigned obedience: Heb. lied}

entries.title: Psalms 81:16
segments: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee. {finest...: Heb. fat of wheat}
